summary: Five executed Multifamily leases within 8 miles of Charlotte and dated 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 were shortlisted and ranked by distance: R1298, R9957 (amended via U-R9957-1), R2302, R6740, and R6049. Effective net rents were computed per the stated undiscounted convention with annual escalations, initial free months, gross expense deductions where applicable, and TI subtracted once. One duplicate pair (Alder Park 1) was resolved by selecting S-R1298 over S-R1927. Several records were excluded for being non-executed, missing required fields (free months, TI, expenses, rent, or term), outside the date window, beyond 8 miles, non-Multifamily, or published post-cutoff.
limitations: Records with missing free_months (e.g., R8015) or TI (e.g., R4144) were excluded; if those data exist elsewhere, results could change.
Gross leases require annual_expenses_psf; where absent (e.g., R7480), comps could not be computed.
Post-cutoff evidence (e.g., U-R2302-2, S-R2337) was not applied; later changes may affect current economics.
Calculations follow an undiscounted rent-only convention and may differ from market appraisals; minor rounding may affect cents-level precision.
Assumes step-ups occur exactly at months 13, 25, etc.; no mid-period proration beyond initial free-month application.
